title: DSNI: Recommending Bacterial Cultivation Conditions from 16S rRNA
description: Code for DSNI, a dataset that pairs one 16S rRNA gene sequence per bacterial strain with four cultivation conditions (growth medium, temperature, pH, oxygen requirement) drawn from BacDive, MediaDive and NCBI, with a genus-disjoint train/val/test split, a scripted rebuild, and baseline models.
